title: Data Sync
seo: Data sync between your app and other systems
meta: Keep customers, orders or products matched between your product and other tools, with a clear sync report. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Data sync that keeps records matched
overview: We build a sync that keeps records the same in two places, for example customers in your app and your CRM, or products in your store and your stock system. We agree which side wins when values differ, match records by a shared ID, run the first full copy, then keep them updated on a schedule or when something changes. A report shows what synced and what did not.

faq: How do you decide which record wins in a conflict?
Before building, we write a short rule with you, such as newest change wins or the CRM always wins. You approve it, and the sync follows it so results stay predictable.
Will the first sync overwrite my data?
Not without your say. We run the first copy on a small test group, show you the result, and only then run the full set. We recommend a backup first.
How much data can it handle?
Tens of thousands of records are fine for these packages. If you have far more, tell us in the order form so we plan batching and confirm the scope in writing.
Any system with an API, export or database access, such as your app, Shopify, a CRM, an email tool or a spreadsheet. We check access with you before you pay.
